description: A floating, flickering entity of glowing embers and shimmering heat. The Fireside Wisp is often found in the wilderness near campfires, drawn to the warmth and energy of flames. It appears as a small sphere of swirling embers that crackles softly like a fire. While not inherently hostile, it can be unpredictable, flaring up in bursts of intense heat when provoked.
languages: Ignan, understands Common but cannot speak
lair_type: Campfires, small caves with lingering warmth

traits.name: Incorporeal Movement
traits.description: The Fireside Wisp can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. It takes 5 (1d10) force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

traits.name: Heated Aura
traits.description: Creatures within 5 feet of the Fireside Wisp at the start of their turn take 3 (1d6) fire damage.

actions.name: Ember Flare
actions.description: The Wisp emits a burst of heat and light in a 15-foot radius. All creatures within range must make a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw or take 12 (2d8+3) fire damage and be blinded until the end of their next turn. On a successful save, they take half damage and are not blinded.

actions.name: Touch of Flame
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d6+3) fire damage.
